name: editing-experiment
description: Lightweight ingest, captioning, develop and FTP app for sports photographers.

scripts.test: pnpm check:e2e-coverage && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm build:native && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm build:native && pnpm --filter @ee/desktop run dev
scripts.screenshot: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm build && node scripts/screenshot.ts
scripts.test:unit:windows: vitest run --exclude "**/*.e2e.test.ts" --exclude "**/real-mode.smoke.test.ts" --exclude "**/*.browser.test.ts" packages/ingest packages/export packages/metadata packages/retouch packages/contracts crates/core apps/desktop/test/backend.integration apps/desktop/test/photo-delete.test apps/desktop/test/library-remove apps/desktop/test/ingest-template-preset apps/desktop/test/export-service apps/desktop/test/export-queue apps/desktop/test/reconcile apps/desktop/test/credentials apps/desktop/test/jobs-handlers apps/desktop/test/app-protocol apps/desktop/test/edited-previews.test apps/desktop/test/metadata-service apps/desktop/test/export-next-to-photo apps/desktop/test/export-capture-time apps/desktop/test/export-file-time apps/desktop/test/ingest-modified-time apps/desktop/test/settings-store apps/desktop/test/app-resources
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/app-launch.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/real-mode.smoke.test.ts apps/desktop/test/zoom-pan.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/zoom-pixel-grid.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/focused-modes.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/delete-photos.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/remove-from-library.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/resizable-sidebars.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/filter-bar.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/develop-photo-first.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/ingest-cards.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/caption-instant-replacement.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/app-launch.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/filter-bar.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/resizable-sidebars.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/develop-photo-first.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/ingest-cards.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/caption-instant-replacement.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:demo: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern="ingests three sources|Photo Mechanic template|code replacement|Lightroom preset and a moved exposure|wires the histogram|crops to 1:1|detects faces|finishes at the export size|edited in the film strip|linear image too|batch exports a retouched photo|full-resolution crop"
scripts.test:e2e:crop: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts apps/desktop/test/real-mode.smoke.test.ts --testNamePattern="Lightroom-style crop overlay|real mode smoke"
scripts.test:e2e:export: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vitest run --no-file-parallelism apps/desktop/test/poc-demo.e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern="batch exports three|batch exports and sends|never overwrites"
